items.title: Chapter 5: Object-Oriented Programming
items.description: Martin revisits the three pillars of OOP — encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism — and argues that OO's true architectural gift is safe, convenient polymorphism that enables plugin architecture and dependency inversion.

items.title: OSI & TCP/IP Models
items.description: The OSI 7-layer model and TCP/IP 4-layer model — each layer's role, protocols, and how data encapsulation works end-to-end.
